lines.en: I drift forward in the water.
My small fins beat once.
I slide off the bank into the water.

lines.zh: 我慢慢地沉下去又浮上来。
lines.en: I sink slowly, then rise again.
I hop up onto the bank.
I circle this patch of water.
I slid into the deep hollow by the bank.
I roll back into the water.
I slide from the shallows into the deep.
I swim past the stone.
My body pulses.
I am easy in the water.
I surfaced for a breath of air.
My color is much like the water.
I blow a small bubble.
A ring spreads on the surface.

lines.zh: 尾巴一摆，我又沉回水底。
lines.en: One flick of my tail and I sink back under.
I settled a little lower.

lines.zh: 浅滩的石子硌着我的肚皮。
lines.en: The pebbles of this shallows poke my belly.
I squelched out half a cry.

lines.zh: 水里打个滚，我换个方向。
lines.en: I roll in the water and face another way.
I rub against the water weeds.
I surface and look at you.
You crouch at the bank, close to the water.
Are you the one who raises me?
You have stirred the water.
I rise a little higher.
I looked up at you for ages.
I blow a bubble.
Do not put your hand in too deep.
I follow along the water's edge.
I like this stretch of water.

lines.zh: 你身上连条尾巴都没有。
lines.en: You do not even have a tail.
In the water I fear no one.

lines.zh: 我一滑就从他手里挣开。
lines.en: One slip and I was out of its grip.
I shrank to a tiny blob.
That blow spread me out.
I sank and resurfaced.
I jiggled like jelly.
I spread flat on the water.
I slowly set again.
I am still afloat on the surface.

lines.zh: 我贴着水边的浅泥待着。
lines.en: I keep to the shallow mud at the edge.
Is that feed for me?
One tail beat took me over.
Can I bite through this?
Up close it smells good.
I opened my mouth and swallowed it.
A little more; that is not enough.
I circle by your hand.
I have smelled this before.
I eat fast, afraid of being robbed.
Is there more in your hand?
I eat with my eye on your hand.

lines.zh: 泡在水里，我轻得像片叶。
lines.en: In the water I am light as a leaf.
I drifted off and drifted back.
I am slippery.
A small ring widens on the surface.
I drifted steady again.
Do not step on me in the water.
I sink and resurface.
I am slippery; I bear you no grudge.
I am too small to understand.
I have not learned that yet.

lines.zh: 我一下沉进水里不露头。
lines.en: I sink out of sight.
I have not even finished training.
I drift off somewhere else with the water.
I blew a small bubble.
That is not something to ask me now.
My head is full of nothing but food.
Call me and I will come.

lines.zh: 水草缠住的东西，我抱在怀里。
lines.en: I hug the thing tangled in the waterweed.

lines.zh: 这东西不像能咽下去的。
lines.en: This does not look swallowable.
It keeps sinking to the bottom.
I push it from underwater.
I butted it with my head.
I cannot even tow this.
I gave it one lick.
I spat that taste out.
I will tuck this into the weeds.
It drifted away from me.
I surface and lift my body.
Something is moving under the water.
My body went taut.
I have filled my cheeks with air.
I swim ahead of you.
I gave a squelching cry.
I fight better in the water.
I dived first.
I swim that way, body swinging.
I will protect my tamer.
The water shields me.
I have my position.
I follow along the water.
You go up the bank, and I follow.
I am faster than it in the water.
I hold my breath in my mouth.
I swim along your boot.

lines.zh: 水草缠了一下，我钻过去。
lines.en: The weeds snagged me; I pushed through.
I have surfaced again.
My cheeks are full of held air.
My cheeks are round with air.
This one comes from below.
I bounced up into it.
I butt it from underneath.
That was a soft one.
The bubble spreads in the water.
I smeared myself onto it.
I lunged and came apart instead.
I slid aside along the water.
I came back up out of the water.
I put effort into that.
One squeeze and it backed off.
I never once left this water.

lines.zh: 水面下多了一小团影子。
lines.en: A small shadow appears under the surface.

lines.zh: 我从水底慢慢浮上来了。
lines.en: I rose slowly from the bottom.
I roll out of the water onto the bank.
This water is clear.
Rings rolled out across the water.
I poked my head above water to look.

lines.zh: 岸上站着一个人看着我。
lines.en: Someone stands on the bank watching me.
I am back near my anchor.

lines.zh: 我本来就不怕水，可这太多了。
lines.en: I am not afraid of water, but this is too much.

lines.zh: 爆风把我从水里掀起来。
lines.en: The blast lifts me out of the water.

lines.zh: 有东西从我身上穿了个洞。
lines.en: Something punched a hole through me.

lines.zh: 一股力把水定住了，我也动不了。
lines.en: Some force stills the water, and me with it.
Hunger leaves me unable to float.

lines.zh: 雷打进水里，我整只都麻了。
lines.en: Lightning enters the water and I go numb.

lines.zh: 没有水，我飘不下去也浮不上来。
lines.en: No water; I can neither sink nor float.
